headline: Executive order signed April 23, 2025, directs changes to how colleges and universities are accredited.
what_it_does: This executive order addresses accreditation, the process private groups use to review and approve colleges and universities. Its title says it aims to reform that process. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps it orders are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Schools could face changes in how they are reviewed and approved by accrediting groups.
The groups that review colleges are the main focus of the order's changes.
Accreditation affects whether a school's students can get federal student aid, so changes to the process could matter to them.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 23, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the available material.
